verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs describe creating an 'application' to obtain API credentials/keys (gusto-docs-51) and an MCP server for AI coding tools to query the API (gusto-docs-6, gusto-docs-34), but there is no evidence of any mechanism for issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials specifically for an autonomous agent (e.g., granular OAuth scopes, read-only vs write API keys, or agent-specific token minting).
